changelog:
- Initial release of the Weekly Report Generator skill.
- Converts mixed engineering records into concise, manager-ready Chinese R&D weekly reports.
- Filters out deployment, environment, operational, installation, and troubleshooting details automatically.
- Retains and merges only valuable business R&D achievements and optimizations.
- Outputs reports in polished Chinese Markdown, with clear structure for both dated and undated inputs.
- Includes automatic report highlights and next-week plans based on detected core work themes.
summary: Generate polished Chinese R&D weekly reports from recent work logs, chat history, commit notes, or development notes. Use when the user asks to 生成、整理、润色、汇总本周...
